name: Twenty Worlds Agency. The Stories of Department 13
source:
Twenty Worlds Agency it's like the CIA or Interpol but agents are recruited from people who have the talent to jump between worlds. You play as an agent from department 13.

During the story, you will meet many girls from different fantasy races like elves, demons, vampires, etc.

[From [url=https://ariohdaerthe.itch.io/twenty-worlds-agency]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
二十个世界机构就像中央情报局或国际刑警组织，但特工是从有能力在世界之间跳跃的人中招募的。你扮演13部门的特工。

在故事中，你会遇到许多来自精灵、恶魔、吸血鬼等不同奇幻种族的女孩。

[来自[url=https://ariohdaerthe.itch.io/twenty-worlds-agency]Itch.io[/url]]
